purpose: Inspect typed bounded operations before implementing a local-link search.

first_discovery.query: exact rational linear inequality or finite graph rank counterexample
first_discovery.finding: Exact rational linear programs can check scalar consequences, but their feasibility region is not the space of admissible normalized pictures. No scalar LP witness will be treated as a counterpicture.

capability_mismatch: The inspected graph.multigraph.cycle_multicover.check validates a submitted cycle family; it does not enumerate all port-colored simple links or their selected subsets. A custom exact local enumeration is needed. The bounded adapter run only cross-checks the K2,3 fan incidence and a three-cycle double cover, not the fragment theorem.
typed_result: All three submitted cycles are valid and cover each of the six K2,3 edges exactly twice.
mathematical_verdict: Exact template cross-check only; no fragment or normalization conclusion.
